items.title: 30.6 1H NMR se molecule ki mumkin banawat maloom karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of deducing a structure from 1H NMR (PDF 211).

blocks.text: Na-maloom compound ki banawat us ke 1H NMR spectrum se maloomat ko paheli ki tarah jor kar maloom ki ja sakti hai.

items: Peaks ginein: peaks ki tadaad proton environments ki tadaad hai.
Har peak ki chemical shift se functional groups pehchanein (Table 30.1).
Peak areas se har environment mein hydrogen atoms ki tadaad maloom karein.
Batna dekhein: sub-peaks ki tadaad = n + 1, is liye n (saath wale protons) = sub-peaks ki tadaad - 1.

blocks.title: Peaks environments ginti hain, protons nahi
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai 'peaks ki tadaad = protons ki tadaad'. Peaks ki tadaad proton environments ki tadaad ke barabar hai; har environment mein protons ki tadaad peak areas se milti hai.

blocks.caption: Misal 30.2: aik ester ka 1H NMR spectrum

blocks.text: Teenon signals jorne se banawat CH3-CO-O-CH2-CH3, ethyl ethanoate, milti hai.

blocks.title: 3.9 ppm ka signal quartet hai
blocks.text: Kitab ka table 3.9 ppm ke signal ko 2 - 1 = 1 parosi wala doublet kehta hai. Oxygen ke saath CH2 ke teen parosi protons (CH3) hain, is liye yeh quartet hai: 4 - 1 = 3.

blocks.alt: Oopar: kitab ki qeematon se spectrum ka khaaka, 3.9 ppm par quartet (2H), 2.2 ppm par singlet (3H) aur 1.3 ppm par triplet (3H). Neeche: banawat CH3-CO-O-CH2-CH3, notes har signal ko us ke group se milate.
blocks.caption: 1H NMR spectrum se ethyl ethanoate ki banawat maloom karna (Misal 30.2 ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: 2.2 ppm ka singlet C=O ke saath CH3 hai jis ka koi parosi H nahi. 3.9 ppm ka quartet aur 1.3 ppm ka triplet mil kar ethyl group hain, jis ka CH2 oxygen ke saath hai. Inhein jorne se ester CH3COOCH2CH3 milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethyl group (-CH2CH3) kaun sa jora signals deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Quartet (CH2, area 2, CH3 se bata) aur triplet (CH3, area 3, CH2 se bata).

items: Peaks = environments; shifts = groups; areas = H ki tadaad; batna = parosi.
